gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: Their son grew ___ and moved abroad.
They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
Who will take ___ from the current director?
gaps.explanation: take over = take control of a job/company.

gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The subject cropped ___ again at dinner.
gaps.explanation: crop up = appear or happen unexpectedly.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.
